source_title: Patrick Stewart Has Died At Age 86
source_excerpt:
The renowned actor Sir Patrick Stewart has passed away at the age of 86. Fans of Patrick Stewart's from across his myriads of roles in film, stage, and video games over the course of 60 years are reeling from the news.
Patrick Stewart had an incredible career, winning numerous awards for his work onstage and on the silver screen, including four Primetime Emmy Awards, three Golden Globes, a Tony Award, and even a Grammy. He became Sir Patrick Stewart in 2010, when he was knighted by the Queen of England, Elizabeth II. Though he's appeared in all kinds of series and films over the years, he's best known in pop culture for his roles as Captain Jean-Luc Picard on Star Trek: The Next Generation , and Professor X in the X-Men live action film franchise.
It's been officially announced that Sir Patrick Stewart passed away at his home at the age of 86, on October 28. His spokesperson , Kelly Bush Novak, stated that the cause was a brief battle with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. The news came as a shock to fans, especially since the actor was still quite active, with voice performances in two roles in 2026 and an upcoming appearance in Avengers: Doomsday , reprising his role as Professor X.
In addition to being credited in no less than 10 Star Trek video games, and many other adaptations of his TV and movie work, he also provided his talent to games like Castlevania: Lords of Shadow , Lego Universe , and The Sims Medieval . His first video game role was as Richard in Lands of Lore: The Throne of Chaos back in 1994. However, the role he's likely best known for by gamers, though a brief one, was as Emperor Uriel Septim VII of The Elder Scrolls: Oblivion . Patrick Stewart's voice serves as the introduction to the game and its world, before players meet his character directly in the opening moments of their adventure, where he sets the player character's destiny in action.

His earliest role on-screen was in 1967, though he had been active onstage for years prior to that. In addition to his aforementioned roles, Stewart appeared in films like the original Dune and Robin Hood: Men in Tights , and provided his voice to numerous characters in movies like The Prince of Egypt , Ice Age: Continental Drift , the English dub of Nausicaa of the Valley of the Wind , and many more. His list of credits is incredibly extensive, as his talent and stage presence quickly established him as a remarkable actor early in his career.
While it's likely that Patrick Stewart has gained fans from all of his roles over the years, the Star Trek community is particularly reeling from his loss. His role as the Captain on Star Trek: The Next Generation helped steer the franchise into a new era after Star Trek: The Original Series had been canceled 18 years prior. His loss also notably follows the death of Walter Koenig, who portrayed Pavel Chekov on the original run of Star Trek , by just three days. Patrick Stewart's passing will undoubtedly be felt for years as he leaves a tremendous legacy behind.
